# TableSnap

> TableSnap is a Chrome extension that turns any table or repeating list on a web page into clean rows. You can download them as Excel (.xlsx) or CSV, paste them into Google Sheets, copy them as Markdown/JSON for an AI assistant, or send them to a webhook. Everything runs inside the user's browser; extracted data never reaches TableSnap's servers.

## What it does
- Point-and-click extraction of HTML tables and of "lists of cards" (search results, product grids, Google Maps results, directories, LinkedIn results, Booking listings).
- Automatic column names (title, price, rating, reviews, address, link…) and clean numbers in Excel.
- Pagination: follows "Next" buttons, "Load more" buttons and infinite scroll, removing duplicate rows.
- Optional contact lookup ("Find emails & phones"): visits the websites listed in the user's table and collects the public emails, phone numbers and social links they publish.
- Interface in English, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil), French and German.

## Pricing
- Free: unlimited rows to Excel, CSV, Google Sheets and AI formats; pagination up to 3 pages; contact lookup on 3 links.
- Pro: $9/month or $49/year. Contact lookup on every row, pagination up to 100 pages, webhooks (n8n, Make, Zapier). 14-day money-back guarantee. Sold through Polar.sh (Merchant of Record).
